repaired_failures: Offline torchrun standalone rendezvous tried to resolve the sandbox hostname. Explicit static loopback rendezvous fixes startup.
Distributed buffer broadcasts between the document and query forwards mutated BERT position-ID buffers. Disabling broadcast_buffers preserves the shared encoder gradient graph.
